LanguageData.DeltaV_PilotGravityRestricted: In gravity, a grav engine and thrusters can only make short, targeted ballistic hops. Free non-targeted flight is available only in zero gravity.
LanguageData.DeltaV_AutoTaskLost: Automatic task target lost; switched to free drift.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavigationNoReference: No usable reference object is visible.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavigationTargetLost: Navigation target lost; switched to free drift.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavigationSubjectLost: Ship can no longer be driven; navigation ended.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavigationNoThrust: No usable thrust remains; navigation ended.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavigationTimedOut: Navigation timed out; switched to free drift.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavigationDragHint: Drag out the desired bow heading; hold the reference modifier on release for a moving reference.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsHideEmptySpaceMaps: Hide space map groups without player pawns
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsHideEmptySpaceMapsTip: On by default. Hide colonist bar groups for SpaceObject maps without living player-faction pawns, reducing enemy ship and debris clutter. Held pawns, player animals and mechs also count. Surface maps and caravans are unaffected. Changes apply immediately.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsTestSceneTip: Choose the prefabs and starting poses for the next two-ship test scene. Settings are shared across saves. The prefab list includes subfolders and rescans when opened. If a selected file fails to load, the existing scene is preserved.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsTestSceneDistanceTip: Initial spherical distance between the ships' centers, 1–10000 cells; default 65.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsTestSceneBearingTip: Initial direction from the player ship to the enemy in the player's universe tangent plane: east is 0°, north is 90°, increasing counterclockwise. This does not rotate with the player ship. Range 0–360°; default about 22.62°.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsTestScenePlayerAngleTip: Initial rotation of the player ship map relative to universe east, increasing counterclockwise. Range 0–360°; default 0°.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsTestSceneEnemyAngleTip: Initial rotation of the enemy ship map relative to universe east, increasing counterclockwise. Range 0–360°; default 35°.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsTestSceneAutomatic: Automatic: latest export (procedural ship if unavailable)
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsTestSceneScanFailed: Could not scan the prefab directory. See the log.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TestScenePrefabFailed: Could not load test scene prefab: {0}. The existing scene was preserved. Select another file or check the log.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsFlightAssistTip: While piloting, released directions are automatically counter-thrusted to a stop - braking uses the ship's real thruster output, so weak thrusters stop you slowly. Turn off for pure inertial flight: the ship keeps drifting at its current velocity - but holding Ctrl (rebindable) still brakes you at any time, so you keep both the freedom and the control. On by default.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsCellsPerTileTip: How empty space is: larger values place neighboring sectors farther apart, so flying across one sector under thrust takes longer; smaller values make sectors more compact and travel faster. Changes apply immediately - every object's position rescales to the new measure (velocities keep their values). Cannot be changed while docking or launching is in progress; the edit is then rejected and reverted. Range 100-100000; default 20000.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ScaleChangeBlocked: Sector scale cannot be changed while docking or launching is in progress.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsLogNote: Module-gated verbose logs ([DeltaV:Module] prefix) for troubleshooting; all off by default, keep them off in normal play. Warnings, errors and key state transitions (pilot enter/exit, key suppression, patch init) are always logged regardless.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsLogDevelopmentTip: Temporary diagnostics for issues currently being investigated. Filter by [DeltaV:Development].
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsLogPerformanceTip: Log FPS, actual TPS, frame time, ambient dust quads, peak object and projectile counts, structure changes, and average/peak CPU time for Delta-V drawing and combat tick stages. Off by default; CPU timings do not measure GPU time.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsUniverseZoomMaxTip: How far the camera can zoom out while focused on a ship map. Larger values show more of space on screen at once - distant ship and station shells enter view sooner - at the cost of everything on the map appearing smaller. Range 60-5000; default 400.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsPoiActiveRadiusTip: Approaching a station, wreck or other object within this distance generates and keeps its interior map (enterable, dockable, boardable). Larger values bring distant objects to life sooner, at the cost of more simultaneously active maps. Keep below the delete radius. Range 50-10000; default 300.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsPoiDeleteRadiusTip: Once you leave an object farther than this, its interior map is packed into a snapshot and restored as-is on your next visit; maps still holding ships or people are only put to sleep, never packed. Larger values make revisits instant but use more memory. Keep above the load radius. Range 100-50000; default 1200.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsNpcDecisionIntervalTip: How often NPC ships recheck eligibility, targets, doctrine and retreat conditions. Autopilot and firing at the selected target still run each tick. Range 1-600; default 60.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsLifecycleScanIntervalTip: How often distance checks materialize, sleep, archive or restore objects. Movement advances every game tick independently of this interval. Range 1-600; default 60.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsMapGenBudgetTip: How many milliseconds each frame may spend generating an approaching POI's interior map. Larger values finish the map sooner but make frames choppier during generation; smaller values keep frames smooth but take longer. Range 1-16; default 8.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SaveBlockedGenerating: Delta-V is incrementally generating a map ({0}). Please save again after it finishes.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ApproachAborted: Docking failed unexpectedly. The ship remains in free flight and docking can be retried.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailHostMap: No landing map could be resolved for the current position.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailNoTarget: There is no loaded object nearby to synchronize with.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailBusy: Another gravship landing or flight operation is already in progress.
LanguageData.DeltaV_LaunchFailNoThruster: No operational thruster found; the ship cannot separate under thrust and begin free flight.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsoleGizmoPrimaryTip: The ship's heading when beginning free flight follows the primary console's facing.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsolePrimary: This is the primary pilot console.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelNeedsPrimaryConsole: This structure has no primary pilot console. Build a console or set an existing console as primary to control the ship.
LanguageData.DeltaV_MissingPrimaryConsoleDesc: Some substructure domains containing player buildings have no primary pilot console and do not form controllable ships. Build a console or select a player-owned console and set it as primary. A domain with a primary console is protected against reassignment. This alert clears when a primary console is restored.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsoleNeedsFoundation: The console must stand on substructure in a Delta-V map to become primary.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsolePrimaryNotOwned: This domain already has a non-player primary console. Claim that console under the vanilla rules, or destroy it without a backup succeeding, before taking control.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelObjectNotLoaded: Not in visual range yet: approach the object first (unloaded objects cannot be focused).
LanguageData.DeltaV_SubstructureOwnerConflict: Cannot build substructure here: it would touch substructure belonging to multiple different structures.
LanguageData.DeltaV_LandingBlockedForeignSubstructure: Cannot land here: the footprint would touch substructure belonging to another object. Leave a gap and connect via docking ports.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignSubstructureDesc: Pick a target owner, then drag over substructure cells. An entire source domain is protected while it has a primary console. Set that console to backup first (note: if there are multiple consoles, another console facing the same direction may automatically take over when the primary is demoted or destroyed; consider dismantling consoles to prevent this). Domains without a primary console can be assigned to an existing ship or a new owner.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignNoTarget: No reassignable substructure on this map.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignSelected: Target owner set: {0}. Now drag over substructure cells.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockExtendDesc: Extend a sealed docking channel in this port's facing direction, up to the first structure. Fails if nothing stands within range.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockRetractDesc: Fold the docking channel away and restore open space.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockNoFace: No usable docking face within range, or an existing passage blocks the route. Passages cannot be chained.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SectorMapAbandonConfirm: Launching will abandon the map of the current sector, "{0}", by the vanilla unanchored-takeoff rule - the map and everything not leaving with the ship will be permanently lost (build a grav anchor on that map to keep it). Proceed?
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockPlanCancelled: Drift synchronization cancelled. The ship remains in free flight.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockPlanBlocksDesignator: Docking in progress: structural and planning changes are locked. Cancel the docking first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockPlanBlocksLaunch: Docking in progress: gravship launch is locked. Cancel the docking first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PilotWrongFaction: Only player-owned ships can be piloted.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsDockingHoldTicksTip: Drift synchronization requires stable linear velocity and grid orientation; work placement also requires stable position. Maps do not merge automatically. Range 1–600; default 60.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsDockingAngleWindowTip: Docking check: how many degrees of heading error from the marked pose still count as aligned. Larger values dock easier but crooked; smaller values are stricter. Range 0.1-15; default 1.15.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsDockingCancelDistanceTip: While a docking plan is active, it cancels itself once the ship drifts farther than this from the target (so stale plans cannot linger). Larger values tolerate detours; smaller values cancel early and make you restart. Range 50-10000; default 250.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsoleGizmoBackupTip: Release the primary claim without triggering succession. This domain stops forming a controllable ship and its substructure can be reassigned. Set a console as primary to restore ship operations.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelShipRowTip: Select '{0}' as the structure to view. Ship controls are available when it has a primary console.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelHeadingTip: Click a compass direction to rotate the whole ship map to that on-screen facing (buildings rotate into a new pocket map coinciding with the current position). The ship's orbital heading, position and velocity are preserved; free flight only, unavailable during a docking plan.
LanguageData.DeltaV_RotateBlockedPlan: Cannot rotate the ship while a docking plan is active.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SplitWarningToggle: Hull tear warnings: when enabled, pause and ask for confirmation before each split. When disabled, split automatically and show only a top-left message each time. Enabled by default.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SplitAutoNotice: {0}: residual contents are separating before thrust.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SeparationCancelled: Separation cancelled and pilot mode exited. Re-enter pilot mode and thrust to try again.
LanguageData.DeltaV_UndockFragmentsLine: - {0} disconnected fragment(s) of this ship will be left behind as wrecks
LanguageData.DeltaV_LeftBehindLine: - Pawn/item list left behind on this map: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsPassiveDrag: Let Newton keep spinning in his coffin so the ship doesn't have to
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsPassiveDragTip: There is no drag in space, so objects drift and spin forever - unless you turn this switch on and let old Newton keep spinning in his coffin so the ship doesn't have to. The ship then slows down over time even without counter-thrust. Turning it off makes handling more realistic but harder to control, and scattered debris becomes much harder to recover. Not recommended to turn off unless you are a devoted Newton fan or a realism enthusiast. On by default.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsDragLinearHalfLifeTip: While this switch is on, translation speed halves every this many ticks. Smaller stops you sooner; larger drifts longer. Range 1-60000; default 480 (halved every 8 seconds).
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsDragAngularHalfLifeTip: While this switch is on, spin rate halves every this many ticks. Smaller stops the turn sooner; larger spins longer. Range 1-60000; default 180 (halved every 3 seconds).
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsSpaceImpactSoundTip: Play weapon firing, supplemental hit and shield sounds during space combat. Vanilla explosion audio remains under vanilla control. Someone says there is no air in space so sound cannot travel - the archotech mind considers this mortal thinking. On by default.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsKeysHint: Key bindings: open Options → Controls → Key bindings and find Delta-V piloting to change flight, fire control and moving-reference keys.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsSectorIntro: Sector content rules. Global mod settings shared across saves; only sectors not yet generated are affected. Points of interest with an empty (or all-invalid) prefab pool materialize with the procedural template instead.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsSectorMinCountTip: Guaranteed minimum number of objects of this type in each newly generated sector; existing objects are never removed. Zero disables the type.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsSectorSegmentsTip: Random extra objects on top of the base count. Each segment rolls independently: on a hit (chance, %) it appends between 1 and the cap. Stack several segments for a long-tail distribution.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsSectorSegmentTip: Segment: chance (%) to append between 1 and the cap as extra objects of this type.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsSectorPrefabPoolTip: Map prefabs used when a point of interest of this type first materializes (chosen deterministically from its seed, random rotation). Paths are relative to the mod's Prefabs folder. An empty pool prevents this type from spawning; an invalid file cancels materialization.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignProtectedDomain: This substructure domain still has a primary console and cannot be reassigned. Set that console to backup first (note: if there are multiple consoles, another console facing the same direction may automatically take over when the primary is demoted or destroyed; consider dismantling consoles to prevent this).
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignProtectedDomainsSkipped: Skipped {0} cell(s) in domains with primary consoles. Release their primary claims first; other eligible cells are reassigned normally.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelFireControlTip: Cycle the allowed modes with this button or B: automatic, manual, disabled. Manual uses LMB for active main groups and RMB for active secondary groups. Disabled stops all weapons, including point defense and continuous tools; it leaves flight orders and weapon groups unchanged. EVA supports manual and disabled only.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelAutoManeuverTip: Orbit a hostile ship using automatic combat positioning. Enabling replaces the current autopilot task, including docking or waypoint guidance, but keeps the docking plan. A flight key takes manual control. This setting resets after loading.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelWeaponGroupTip: {0} set, group {1}. Click to toggle whether this group is active. Only active groups fire, and they receive gunner priority when crew is short.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelBattleStationsOnTip: Fully reassigns all usable player weapons on this map using the latest gunner reservations; active groups take priority when crew is short.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelBattleStationsOffTip: Releases every current space-weapon post and returns its gunners to normal work.
LanguageData.DeltaV_BattleStationsOff: Battle stations released; {0} gunners return to work.
LanguageData.DeltaV_WeaponGroupGizmoTip: Opens a menu to assign this weapon's salvo set and group (Main/Secondary 1-6). Activation is toggled per group on the status panel.
LanguageData.DeltaV_WeaponPdgizmoTip: Point defense mode: automatically engages interceptable containers (missiles, mapped shots, shuttles) in range. Not controlled by the aim mode.
LanguageData.DeltaV_WeaponReserveGizmoTip: Chooses which colonist mans this weapon when battle stations are called (any = random able colonist).
LanguageData.DeltaV_KeepGunnerWhenUnavailableTip: On by default. An assigned gunner stays at this weapon when power or required ammunition is unavailable. Turn off to release them on the next game tick for other usable weapons. Unavailable weapons do not recruit new gunners.
LanguageData.DeltaV_MagazinePriorityTip: Higher-priority magazines are consumed first. Equal-priority magazines alternate in Thing ID order.
LanguageData.DeltaV_AttachmentEnabledTip: Temporarily enables or disables this weapon attachment. This command supports multi-selection.
LanguageData.DeltaV_BatteryGridOutputTip: When enabled, generate grid power from stored energy at the selected rate, even when demand is lower. Turn off to recharge. Weapon attachments can draw energy directly in either mode.
LanguageData.DeltaV_BatteryOutputWattsTip: Set the maximum power sent to the grid while this battery has stored energy.
LanguageData.DeltaV_StatBeamEnergy: Battery energy per second of illumination
LanguageData.DeltaV_GroundModeTip: When enabled, the vanilla turret attacks targets on this map only. When disabled, it fires across space containers; point-defense mode can still intercept incoming projectiles.
LanguageData.DeltaV_RailAcceleratorSkipped: disconnected or insufficient pulse energy, skipped
LanguageData.DeltaV_SafeFireTip: Prevent fixed weapons from firing when their shot path intersects their own solid hull. Disable only for emergencies.
LanguageData.DeltaV_WeaponNeedsSingleOwner: The entire weapon footprint must be on substructure owned by one ship.
LanguageData.DeltaV_AttachmentNeedsSlot: This attachment must cover a compatible weapon's declared attachment slot.
LanguageData.DeltaV_AttachmentSlotOccupied: This weapon attachment slot is already occupied.
LanguageData.DeltaV_MissileMagazineNeedsLauncher: Place the missile magazine parallel to either inboard side of a missile launcher.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShuttleLaunchGizmoTip: Launch into free flight as a mini-ship. Gate = vanilla launch checks (loadout/fuel/mass/cooldown); on a moon pool the roof never blocks launch.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShuttleBoardGizmoTip: Pick an enemy container's hull: the shuttle becomes a missile under full thrust, punches through and seals the breach with its own cabin.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShuttleBoardNoTarget: No container hull at that spot.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShuttleBoardCancelTip: Disengage missile drive and return to normal shuttle flight at the current position and speed.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelBoardArmTip: Arm the intrusion drive, then pick a target hull. In missile mode, use Abort intrusion to return to shuttle flight.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DebugThrustersToggleButton: Show Delta-V thruster vectors and hull extent
LanguageData.DeltaV_DebugWeaponArcsToggleButton: Show selected weapons' firing arcs and range scan
LanguageData.DeltaV_DebugCollisionToggleButton: Show actual collision cells and broad-phase bounds for all visible objects
LanguageData.DeltaV_FireDeviationTip: Maximum angle between the current barrel or fixed launch axis and the target. Shots follow the actual launch direction; guided missiles can turn afterward.
LanguageData.DeltaV_AutoFireDeviationTip: Maximum angle between the barrel or fixed axis and the target for automatic volleys, point defense, and ground mode.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ManualFireDeviationTip: Maximum angle between the barrel or fixed axis and the mouse direction when firing manually. Mouse distance does not limit manual fire; fixed-axis weapons at 180° fire along their axis from any mouse direction.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldModeDesc: Guard uses shared regular and local emergency capacity. Both line modes require power. Switching neither refills capacity nor resets recovery delay.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldGuardRecoveryPaused: Regular recovery awaits power and an enabled switch.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldGuardReference: Local limits: {0} regular, {1} emergency. Powered recovery starts after 10 seconds without regular consumption; only silver restores emergency capacity. Radius does not change capacity.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldElectromagneticReference: At 30° incidence, active turning adds {0}° after passive refraction.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PrefabReplaceSelect: Select a prefab to replace the entire focused map (old contents will be removed)
LanguageData.DeltaV_PrefabReplaceNoFiles: No prefab XML files were found under Prefabs/.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PrefabReplaceRequiresMap: Focus a loaded Delta-V space map before replacing it.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PrefabReplaceBusy: Wait for map generation, replacement, takeoff or docking to finish before replacing this map.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PrefabReplaceFailed: Prefab map replacement failed. See the error log for details.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PrefabReplaceComplete: Replaced the focused map with prefab: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_SalvageOutputLost: {0}: some recovered materials could not be placed nearby and were lost. Clear space for output.
LanguageData.DeltaV_EVATransferFailed: Extravehicular transfer failed. Maps have been retained. See the log for details.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SyncReady: Drift synchronization is stable. Extravehicular work is available.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsWorksiteMargin: Extra worksite margin on each side (cells)
LanguageData.DeltaV_EVAUnsupportedContent: This map contains objects that cannot be transferred with a gravship. Extravehicular work has not started.
LanguageData.DeltaV_EVAGridCorrection: Adjusting to the extravehicular work placement. Select Begin extravehicular work again once alignment is stable.
LanguageData.DeltaV_EVANotSynchronized: Position, velocity and grid orientation are not yet synchronized.
LanguageData.DeltaV_EVAStarted: Extravehicular work has begun. Applying real thruster power separates that ship from the worksite.
LanguageData.DeltaV_EVAOverlap: Ship structures or map contents overlap. Adjust position and try again.
LanguageData.DeltaV_EVAGravity: Gravity effects prevent extravehicular work here. Dock the entire ship in a clear area of the target map.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SyncStarted: Matching linear velocity and grid orientation with {0}, without a position destination. Begin extravehicular work once synchronized.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SoftDockToggle: Soft docking guides: enable to capture and maintain links. Disabling immediately disconnects and stops soft docking.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SoftDockHaul: Transfer selected cargo or downed pawn
LanguageData.DeltaV_TractorModeDesc:
Click to switch between collecting items and pulling structures.

Collect items: enabling the weapon group automatically recovers allowed drifting cargo and living pawns near the moonpool. Disabling the group stops collection. Manual fire control is not required.

Pull structures: enable the group, select manual fire control, and hold the matching fire button to pull structures hit along the beam. Automatic fire control does not operate structural towing. The default is secondary group 4, fired with the right mouse button. Disconnected components separate before force is applied; your ship receives the reaction. Aim through the target’s center of mass and use an inertia coupler to reduce relative rotation.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TractorNeedsMoonPool: A tractor beam must be built on a moonpool.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TractorBlocked: The moonpool cannot receive these contents. Clear space for recovery.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SoftDockTransferDesc: Choose people and cargo in the standard portal transfer dialog. Vanilla hauling and group duties organize the transfer. Loading can be edited or canceled; disconnecting cancels the transfer.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SoftDockTransferDisconnected: The soft docking connection has disconnected.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SoftDockTransferNoWorker: The remote port is hostile. Hack and claim it first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_MissileMagazineLimitsDesc: Set each missile type's limit within the shared capacity of {0}.
LanguageData.DeltaV_MissileMagazineEjectEntry: {0}: eject one stack per magazine ({1} stored in total)
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAIEditTip: Edit this console or shuttle hull's automatic combat rules.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAICopyMainTip: Copy the current main console strategy to this backup.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAIRuleHelp: The first matching rule applies. A built-in default always follows.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAIConditionHelp: Match all or any conditions; enter values in the metric's units.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAICurveUnit_ProjectileSecon: Earliest enemy weapon impact (seconds; no threat = 8)
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAICurveAxes: Horizontal: {0}; vertical: points added to firing position selection.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAICurveAutomatic: Curve disabled; the preview is an editable template
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAICurveExtend: Extend the last segment beyond its final point
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAICurveInvalid: Invalid points: use at least two, strictly increasing horizontal values within the allowed range.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAIScoreReason: distance {0}, output {1}, incoming {2}, weapon timing {3}, overlap {4}, aim {5}, control {6}
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatTacticHelp: Reposition moves between stable attack positions; hold retains a bearing; circle keeps moving around the target. Real thrust and braking limit movement.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatTacticReason: Range {0} cells, relative facing {1}°, {2}; covered firepower {3}/s, curve preference {4}
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatPrimaryWeapons: Primary weapons for positioning (other weapons remain enabled)
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatAllWeapons: All weapons must match (off=any; empty sets never match)
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatConditionMissing: Missing targets/weapons never match; release thresholds widen the holding interval.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatFlanking: Coordinate flanking with allied automatic combatants
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatPoseHelp: Red=enemy, cyan=own ship. Left drag sets distance and bearing; right drag sets own facing. Changes stay in the draft until the strategy is saved.
LanguageData.DeltaV_WeaponCoverageHelp: Restrict space range and arc within hardware limits. Direction is relative to the mount; positive angles are counterclockwise.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatOrdersHelp: Engage changes the maneuver target; the part queue affects fire control only (up to 16), respecting hold-fire rules. Invalid parts are skipped; an empty queue resumes strategy. These commands do not enable maneuver or fire control.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatPoseStatus: Bearing {0}°, next reposition {1}s; coverage {2}, mobility {3}; distance/output/incoming/time/overlap/alignment scores: {4}
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatPoseBlocked: Explicit constraints conflict with hull/weapon capabilities: maintaining the safest feasible pose.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CombatNoFireChoice: Hold-fire rule active, or no target satisfies range, arc and safety constraints.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldManualEmergencyTip: Pause a partially depleted regular shield to let it recover. Only this generator's emergency capacity absorbs hits while it recovers; damage is no longer shared. Regular protection reactivates at full capacity, regardless of the slider setting. Line mode remains unchanged.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldRegularBarTip:
The bar shows this generator's remaining regular capacity.

After regular capacity is depleted, emergency protection takes over. Drag the marker to choose how much regular capacity must recover before it reactivates (1–100%) and shares damage with the ship's other active regular shields.

Manually switching to emergency protection always waits for full regular capacity. Line mode can restore capacity but never switches back to a dome automatically.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevRegularFullTip: Fill the selected generators' regular capacity and return them from emergency.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevRegularEmptyTip: Empty regular capacity, enter automatic emergency and start the recovery wait.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevSkipRecoveryWaitTip: End the regular recovery wait. Recovery still requires power.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevEmergencyFullTip: Fill local emergency capacity without changing the refueling target.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevEmergencyEmptyTip: Empty local emergency capacity without changing the refueling target.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevHit100Tip: Consume 100 capacity through normal shared and local emergency rules. Hits each selected shield.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevHit1000Tip: Consume 1000 capacity through normal shared and local emergency rules. Hits each selected shield.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevLineFailureTip: Trigger the line shield brownout duration without drawing power.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ShieldDevLineResetTip: End the line shield brownout. The generator must still be switched on and powered.
